scope: Synthetic CPU execution cost on a real local model; no trained-adapter quality claim

adapter.targets: all present supported main-layer projections; excludes next-layer drafts

benchmark_settings.warmup: one full untimed inference pass per sample

native_cli_memory_check.settings: same prompt, arithmetic, seed, threads, batch and context; CLI default cache; max-tokens 16
native_cli_memory_check.weights: the file's own pages, read as they are touched
native_cli_memory_check.measurement: GNU time; single separate CLI run, not a timing repetition

limitations: Shared host: first batch load 2.96..7.61 and temperature 85.875..92.25 C; repeat temperature 87.25..93.25 C
Five paired repetitions per batch are descriptive, not a significance or worst-case latency bound
In-process benchmark RSS remains null; native model accounting excludes borrowed mapped pages
No premerged release arm or before/after no-adapter executable comparison was performed
Results do not qualify the released 27B adapter, other arithmetic policies, long contexts or device execution
